title: Dropshipping Customer Support
description:
About the Role



We operate and scale multiple fashion ecommerce dropshipping brands on Shopify, promoted organically on TikTok.



Our business is growing, and we are looking for someone reliable and structured who can help protect customer relationships, reduce disputes, and safeguard the reputation of our brands.



This role focuses heavily on providing excellent customer support, resolving customer issues quickly and professionally, maintaining customer satisfaction, and helping prevent unnecessary refunds, chargebacks, and negative reviews.



This is a hands-on operational role, not a strategy role.



Main Responsibilities



Disputes & Chargebacks



-Respond to PayPal or card disputes

-Prepare evidence and documentation

-Communicate with customers when needed

-Make decisions on refunds or replacements when appropriate

-Help reduce dispute rates over time



Trustpilot & Reputation



-Monitor Trustpilot reviews

-Respond professionally to negative reviews

-Help resolve customer complaints

-Work toward turning negative reviews into updated or removed reviews



Customer Support & Customer Retention



-Respond to customer
s and inquiries

-Handle shipping and order-related questions

-Follow up with customers regarding ongoing issues

-Help resolve customer concerns before they become disputes or refund requests

-Support a positive customer experience throughout the order journey



Requirements



-Experience handling customer complaints and customer support tickets

-Mandatory experience handling PayPal disputes and dispute resolution

-Shopify customer support experience

-Experience in dropshipping operations

-Strong attention to detail

-Comfortable working with Google Sheets

-Strong written English

-Calm and professional when dealing with difficult situations



Bonus



-Fashion ecommerce experience

-Experience with Trustpilot



Salary



-$5 per hour

-Long-term remote role

-Opportunity to grow into a larger customer operations leadership role as we expand



HOW TO APPLY (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY)



To apply, please follow these steps:



1. Change your application subject to:



“I want to protect CS”



2. Short Written Introduction (4–6 sentences)



Briefly explain:



-Your experience handling customer complaints or disputes

-Why you would be a good fit for this role



3. Send your CV



4. Send a Loom video (3–5 minutes)



In your Loom, please answer the following:



Scenario 1 — Payment Dispute



A customer opens a PayPal dispute claiming they never received their order, but tracking shows the package is still in transit.



How would you handle this situation?



Explain what do you do



Scenario 2 — Trustpilot Review



A customer leaves a 1-star Trustpilot review saying their order is late and the brand is a scam.



How would you handle this situation?



Explain what do you do



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands — but we are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and executes tasks blindly.



We’re looking for people who understand media buying at a strategic level, can think through campaign decisions, recognize patterns in performance, and know when to take action, when to hold, and when to escalate.



You should be able to follow systems carefully, communicate clearly, and execute consistently — while also bringing good judgment, attention to detail, and a strong understanding of why certain decisions are being made.



This is a long-term role with room to grow for the right people.



Position Details

Position: Media Buyer

Openings: 1

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period, paid in USD

Pay Schedule: Paid once every 2 weeks

You will work under the guidance of the Lead Media Buyer and our internal operations system. However, this is not an order-taking role. We expect you to understand the strategy behind the tasks you are executing, think critically about performance, and contribute useful observations when something needs attention.



Core Skills and Requirements



You should:

Have managed Meta ad accounts for e-commerce brands

Understand campaign structure, performance signals, pacing, testing, and optimization basics

Be able to think strategically about what the data is showing, not just make random changes

Know when to act, when to wait, and when to flag something for review

Have project management experience or have used project management tools before

Have a can-do attitude and can adapt to process changes

Managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands

title: Store CRO & Landing Page Testing Specialist for High-Growth Ecommerce Brand
description:
We are looking for a sharp, performance-driven Store CRO & Landing Page Testing Specialist to help improve the conversion performance of a fast-growing ecommerce business doing $150k+ per month in revenue.



This is not a generic “make the website look nicer” role.



We need someone who understands direct-response ecommerce, paid traffic, Shopify-style product pages, landing pages, advertorials, product page testing, offer optimization, and the relationship between Meta Ads creative and on-site conversion.



You will be responsible for finding conversion leaks, creating practical test ideas, improving product pages and landing pages, and helping us turn more paid traffic into profitable customers.



About the Business



We run a Meta Ads-driven ecommerce/dropshipping business selling impulse-buy products through Shopify-style funnels.



Our growth depends on fast execution across:



Meta Ads traffic

Creative testing

Product page optimization

Landing page performance

Advertorials and pre-sell pages

Offer testing

Bundles, quantity breaks, and upsells

Conversion rate, AOV, revenue per session, and contribution margin



We move quickly, test aggressively, and care about numbers.



Main Goal of the Role



Your main goal is to improve the performance of our store and funnels by increasing:



Conversion rate

Average order value

Revenue per session

Landing page conversion performance

Meta Ads funnel efficiency

Profitability from paid traffic



You should be able to look at a product page, landing page, advertorial, or funnel and quickly identify what is hurting performance, what should be tested, and what needs to be improved.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Auditing product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and pre-sell pages

Finding conversion leaks across the customer journey

Improving above-the-fold sections, hero offers, product positioning, and page structure

Testing different product page layouts and landing page formats

Improving product descriptions, benefit sections, objection handling, comparison sections, FAQs, and calls to action

Optimizing offers, bundles, quantity breaks, cart incentives, upsells, and post-purchase flows

Improving trust elements such as reviews, guarantees, shipping messaging, social proof, payment icons, customer photos, and risk reversal

Improving urgency and scarcity elements without making the page feel fake or spammy

Creating and testing advertorials, quiz-style pages, story-based pre-sell pages, and direct-response landing pages

Analyzing Shopify data, Meta Ads data, heatmaps, session recordings, analytics, and ecommerce metrics

Working with media buyers, video editors, copywriters, and the creative team to align ads with landing pages

Turning ad angles and customer objections into landing page sections and test ideas

Documenting test ideas, hypotheses, implementation details, results, learnings, and next steps

Prioritizing tests based on expected impact, speed of execution, and traffic volume

Helping us create a repeatable CRO testing system

Required Skills & Experience



You should have experience with:



Shopify or similar ecommerce platforms

CRO for ecommerce stores receiving paid traffic

Meta Ads traffic and direct-response funnels

Product page optimization for impulse-buy ecommerce products

Landing page and advertorial optimization

A/B testing principles and conversion-focused experimentation

Ecommerce metrics such as CVR, AOV, RPS, CPA, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, checkout conversion rate, and bounce rate

Writing or improving persuasive ecommerce copy

Turning customer objections into page sections

Making data-backed recommendations without overcomplicating things

Heatmaps, scroll maps, session recordings, and analytics tools

Landing page builders and ecommerce apps



You do not need to be a developer, but you should understand what needs to be changed and be able to work with designers, builders, or developers to get tests live.



Nice-to-Have Experience



These are not required, but they are a big plus:



Experience with dropshipping or high-volume ecommerce

Experience with Replo, PageFly, GemPages, Zipify, Shogun, Unbounce, Webflow, or similar landing page builders

Experience with cart drawer optimization

Experience with post-purchase upsells

Experience with checkout optimization

Experience aligning product pages with
/SMS flows

Basic understanding of Meta Ads creative angles, hooks, advertorials, and customer psychology

Experience working with health, beauty, wellness, home, gadget, or impulse-buy products

Experience creating CRO roadmaps for fast-moving ecommerce teams

Key Performance Indicators



We will measure success based on:



Improved conversion rate

Improved average order value

Improved revenue per session

Reduced bounce rate

Improved landing page performance from paid traffic

Higher checkout initiation and purchase rates

Higher offer take rate for bundles, quantity breaks, and upsells

More successful tests shipped per month

Better Meta Ads funnel performance

Clear documentation of test ideas, results, and learnings

Who This Role Is Best For



This role is a strong fit for someone who:



Thinks like a direct-response marketer, not just a UX designer

Understands that paid traffic needs a different landing page approach than organic traffic

Can write clear, persuasive ecommerce copy

Knows how to turn customer objections into conversion assets

Can look at data and make practical recommendations

Moves quickly and does not need everything to be perfect before testing

Cares about performance, not opinions

Can explain why a change should improve conversions

Understands that CRO is about testing, learning, and compounding wins

What to Include When Applying



Please include:



Examples of ecommerce stores, product pages, landing pages, or advertorials you have improved

Before/after results if available

Screenshots, case studies, Loom videos, or portfolio links

Your CRO process

Tools you use for analytics, heatmaps, testing, landing pages, or page building

Your experience with Shopify or similar ecommerce platforms

Your experience with paid traffic, especially Meta Ads traffic

Your availability

Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate

A short explanation of how you would approach improving a product page that receives Meta Ads traffic

Test Task



As part of the hiring process, we may ask you to complete a short paid or unpaid test task:



Audit one product page and provide:



5–10 specific CRO improvements

A rewritten above-the-fold section

One A/B test idea with:

Hypothesis

What you would change

How you would implement it

Success metric

Why you believe it would improve performance



We are not looking for a generic audit. We are looking for specific, practical, direct-response recommendations that can be tested quickly.



How to Apply



Send your application with the examples and details listed above.



Start your message with the word “CRO” so we know you read the full post.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term performance partner and help us scale our ecommerce funnels profitably.

title: Product owner
description:
Product owner / Backlog Administration & Service Desk Specialist (Jira / Jira Service Management)



We are a Dutch SaaS company building an AI-native platform on which organizations run their customer-facing and operational processes — CRM, customer journeys, and workflow management. Our enterprise customers operate in energy, telecom, and field operations, with new verticals coming.



We are looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed specialist to run our service desk and product backlog administration. This is not a ticket-pushing job: customers bring us complex, often vague problems, and you are the one who untangles them, translates them into clear tickets, and thinks along with the customer about the right solution.



You are the first responder on our customer service desks and the guardian of our Jira backlog. You make sure every customer request is acknowledged fast, turned into a well-written ticket, refined until the dev team can pick it up without questions, and kept in sync until it ships. You work alongside modern AI-assisted tooling — we automate the repetitive parts step by step, and you run the process, handle the judgment calls, and keep quality at 100%.



Responsibilities



Service desk first response — acknowledge incoming customer requests within 15 minutes during working hours, across multiple customer service desks (Jira Service Management)

Ticket intake — convert each service desk request into exactly one well-structured Jira ticket (user story, acceptance criteria, correct type/labels/links/epic)

Refinement— drive tickets to Definition of Ready: clarify with stakeholders, attach context, route complex items through the refinement flow, escalate what you cannot resolve

-Complex problem analysis— dig into vague or multi-layered customer problems, ask the right questions, find the root cause, and translate it into clear, actionable tickets — you think along with the customer instead of just logging what they say

Status synchronisation — keep service desk and Jira statuses in sync through the full lifecycle, so customers always see the true state

Delivery & release validation— closely involved in feature delivery: manually test and validate new features and configurations before they reach the customer, and confirm they work after release

Configuration work— resolve configuration-level issues in the platform yourself (settings, templates, setup) instead of routing everything to developers

-Customer communication drafts — prepare release notes and pre/post-release customer updates

Backlog hygiene & reporting — periodic backlog clean-ups, sprint/cycle progress reports, flag bottlenecks and stale tickets

Scrum collaboration— participate in the daily scrum and sprint rituals with our (remote, English-speaking) dev team



Requirements



- 2+ years hands-on experience with **Jira and Jira Service Management** (workflows, boards, linking, JQL is a plus)

- Excellent written English — you write user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer-facing updates

- Extremely detail-oriented and process-driven — status accuracy and ticket quality are the core of this job

- High analytical intelligence (IQ 120+)— you can break a complex, ambiguous problem down to its root cause and concrete next steps. We test cognitive ability as part of the hiring process.

- Reliable availability with overlap with European (CET) morning hours — our response SLA is contractual

- Experience working with Scrum/agile software teams

- Comfortable working with AI-assisted tooling and structured runbooks (we document everything; you follow and improve the playbook)

- Self-starter who escalates early instead of guessing



Nice to have



- Experience with manual QA / acceptance testing of web applications

- Experience configuring SaaS platforms (workflows, templates, settings)

- Experience at a SaaS / software product company

- Confluence experience

- Basic understanding of software release cycles (staging vs production)



How to apply



Reply with:

1. A short note on your Jira/JSM experience (which workflows you managed, team size)

2. One example of a user story + acceptance criteria you wrote (or write one for a feature of your choice)

3. A short description of a complex problem you untangled for a customer or team: what was unclear, what did you do, what was the outcome

4. Your available working hours in CET



Shortlisted candidates will take a cognitive ability test and complete a small trial task.



Applications without these three items will not be considered.

title: Appointment Setter — B2B Healthcare Outreach (US Clinics)
description:
The short version:



We're running the 2026 Supplier Risk Benchmark, a benchmark study with licensed US clinics and telehealth providers in the compounded peptide, GLP-1, HRT/TRT, and longevity space. Your job is to find the right clinic operators and book them into a short, confidential interview with our founder.



This is a recruitment role, not a sales role. You are not selling a product, closing a deal, or pitching anything. You're inviting qualified clinics to take part in an industry study — and the offer to them is genuinely good: a 20–30 minute conversation in exchange for early access to the benchmark findings their peers will be paying attention to.



If you have a sales background, that's useful — but the 
nt this turns into a pitch, it's the wrong move. We'll train you on the framing.



What you'll do:



- Build and source targeted lists of US-based licensed clinics and telehealth operators in: longevity / anti-aging, functional medicine, men's health / TRT, hormone therapy, and GLP-1 / peptide prescribing.

- Reach the right decision-maker — owner, medical director, or operations/compliance lead — by phone, with
 as follow-up.

- Invite them to participate in the benchmark and book confirmed interviews through our 
 link (
/pepteye/benchmark-interview).

Lightly qualify before you book (see the filter below) so the founder's time only goes to relevant operators.

- Make sure the consent checkbox is completed at booking — participation is confidential and used in anonymized, aggregate form only. You'll communicate this clearly when booking.

- Send confirmations and reminders to minimize no-shows — a booking only counts when the clinic actually shows up.

- Track every touch, booking, and outcome in a shared Google Sheet



The qualification filter (this is the most important part):



Book: licensed, prescriber-led operations — clinics or telehealth groups where a licensed prescriber writes scripts and product reaches patients through a compounding pharmacy (503A/503B) or similar legitimate channel.



Do NOT book: gray-market / "research use only" sellers — operations that move vials direct-to-consumer with no prescriber in the chain ("we sell the vials, the customer handles the rest"). They are not who this study is for. No matter how interested or friendly they sound, they're not a fit — skip them.



A simple way to tell: Is there a licensed prescriber and a real pharmacy between them and the patient? If yes, qualify. If it's vials-and-a-website with no prescriber, pass.



Targets:



- Week-one paid trial: deliver 3–4 booked, qualified, confirmed interviews. This is how we d
 to continue together.

- Ongoing: 20 completed, qualified interviews within 30 days. "Completed" means the clinic showed up and the founder ran the interview — not just a calendar slot.



You're a fit if you have:



- Near-native US English, written and spoken — you'll be talking to US clinic owners and medical staff, and you need to sound credible and natural on the phone.

- A track record in B2B appointment-setting or cold outreach with real numbers you can share (booked rate, volume, show rate).

- Strong organization and self-direction — you can build a list, work it, and keep clean records without being managed.

- Professional discretion and comfort operating in a healthcare / compliance-sensitive context.

- Reliable overlap with US business hours (ET–PT) for calls and bookings.

- A clear understanding that this is recruitment, not sales.



Big plus (not required, but a real advantage):



- Existing contacts or a network in US clinics — compounding pharmacies, peptide / GLP-1 / HRT-TRT / longevity / anti-aging clinics, med spas, functional-medicine practices, or telehealth groups. Warm introductions or existing, accurate contact lists are a major advantage and we'll weight them heavily.

- Prior medical, aesthetic, wellness, or telehealth outreach experience.

- Familiarity with the compounded peptide / GLP-1 landscape.



What you will NOT be doing:



- Running the interviews (the founder does that).

- Selling, quoting, or pitching any product or service.

- Giving any medical, legal, or regulatory advice.



Tools:

In 3–4 sentences (your own writing, no AI), tell us why this role fits you.

title: Amazon Image & Design Specialist, Premium & Heritage Brands
description:
We are an established Amazon agency (20+ years) managing premium and heritage brands in tabletop, glassware, home, and gift. We are hiring an experienced image and design specialist to create and improve listing images, A+ content, and video for these brands.

The core challenge here is different from commodity or private-label work: our products are expensive and often look like generic versions of themselves in a flat photo. A $90 hand-finished ceramic bowl can look identical to a $15 one on screen. The job is making a shopper understand the price difference through the images alone. If your portfolio is mostly text-heavy feature infographics for commodity products, this is not the right role.

What the role involves:



Full image sets: main image, lifestyle and in-context shots, feature and scale callouts, collection cross-sell, and branding and proof images (stamps, gift boxes, made-in, designer, patents, warranty)

A+ content and storefront visuals

Video, including AI-assisted editing of human-shot footage, with correct scale and no artifacts

Researching each brand before designing so the work matches the brand's tone and the real reasons customers buy

Iterating on creative based on performance, customer questions, and competitor benchmarks

Following brand guidelines and license restrictions (some licenses prohibit AI-generated visuals)



Requirements:



Several years of hands-on Amazon image and A+ design with a portfolio you can show

Experience with premium or design-forward products, not just feature callout infographics

Competence with AI image and video tools combined with clear judgment about where they fall short

Familiarity with Amazon image and video technical requirements

ClickUp for tasks and time tracking (we will train you)

Consistent daily hours with some overlap with US Eastern Time



How to apply (applications that skip these steps are not reviewed):



Start your subject line with the word MONTAUK.

Include a portfolio link. Point specifically to one Amazon listing or image set you designed for a premium or higher-priced product and tell me in two or three sentences what you were trying to achieve with it.

Answer these three questions in your own words. Generic or AI-written answers are easy to identify and will not be considered.



a. We sell a $90 hand-finished ceramic serving bowl from a heritage brand. In a flat photo it looks like any other bowl. How do you design the image set so a shopper understands why it is worth far more than a $15 version?



b. How do you use AI image and video tools in your work, and where do they fall short for premium products? Give one specific thing you would not trust AI to handle.



c. You are assigned a brand you have never designed for. What do you do between getting the assignment and starting your first image concepts?

Include your CV.

title: Lead Manager (Phone Sales / Appointment Setting)
description:
About LBH



LBH is a vacant land acquisition company. We run direct mail campaigns that put us in front of property owners who are ready to sell, and we turn those conversations into deals. We move fast, we keep our pipeline full, and everyone on the team owns their numbers.



We're looking for a Lead Manager who loves working warm leads and knows how to turn an interested seller into a booked appointment.



The Role



You are the first point of contact for our sellers. When someone responds to one of our mail campaigns, the lead comes straight to you. Your job is to reach out fast, build rapport, understand their situation and their property, and get them scheduled with our acquisitions team.



These are warm leads. The people you reach out to already raised their hand. Your job is to be quick, friendly, and organized enough that no opportunity slips through the cracks. This is a metrics-driven seat: you'll own your response speed, your appointment-set rate, and your follow-up discipline, with clear targets to hit every week.



What You'll Do



- Reach out to warm, inbound leads quickly. Speed to lead is everything in this role.

- Build genuine rapport and understand each seller's motivation, situation, and timeline.

- Qualify the lead and gather the key property details our acquisitions team needs.

- Set appointments and hand them off cleanly so the acquisitions manager can make an offer.

- Run consistent, organized follow-up on leads that aren't ready to talk yet.

- Keep the CRM accurate and fully updated on every single contact.

- Hit weekly targets for leads worked, sellers engaged, and appointments set.



What We're Looking For



- Proven experience in outbound sales, appointment setting, or inside sales. This is non-negotiable.

- A natural communicator who builds trust and rapport fast.

- Strong listener with real curiosity about people and their situations.

- Highly organized, with disciplined and reliable follow-up habits.

- Comfortable being measured on your numbers and fully owning your results.

- Self-motivated and dependable in a remote setting.

- Comfortable working inside CRM software.



Big Plus (Not Required)



- Experience working with land investors or in real estate (land, wholesaling, or REI).

- Familiarity with motivated-seller conversations and acquisitions funnels.

- You already know what "speed to lead" and "appointment-set rate" mean before you read this post.



What We Offer



- A steady flow of warm leads. You won't be prospecting from scratch.

- Uncapped earning potential tied directly to the appointments you set and deals that close.

- A clear weekly scorecard so you always know exactly where you stand.

- A growing company where strong performers can take on more responsibility over time.



How to Apply



Send your application here. In the subject line, put your favorite color.



Your application must include two things:



- A short video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself and telling us why you would be great at turning warm leads into booked appointments. A link works best (Loom, an unlisted YouTube video, or Google Drive).

- Your resume.



We read every application closely. Anything missing the favorite color in the subject line, the video, or the resume will not be reviewed.

mbers to ensure design, captions, hashtags, and scheduling are completed correctly.

title: Amazon Brand Management Agency – Bisonbody
description:
Position: Amazon Brand Management Agency – Bisonbody



Industry: E-commerce / Health & Wellness

Brand: BISONBODY



ROLE

We are looking for a highly experienced Amazon-focused agency or full-service brand management team to fully manage and scale our Amazon brand, Bisonbody.



This is not a standard Brand Manager role. We are seeking a long-term agency partner that can independently operate and grow the brand with minimal to no involvement from our internal team. The ideal agency should be capable of taking full ownership of the account operations, strategy, performance optimization, and growth initiatives while keeping us informed through regular reports and updates.



The selected agency will be responsible for managing the entire Amazon ecosystem of the brand — from PPC and listings to inventory forecasting, product launches, profitability, and overall account health.



Our expectation is simple:

You manage and grow the brand independently while providing us with clear updates, reports, and strategic recommendations.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Fully manage and oversee all Amazon account operations on a daily basis

• Handle end-to-end Amazon brand growth strategy and execution

• Manage and optimize PPC campaigns for profitability and scaling

• Monitor and improve SKU performance across all marketplaces

• Optimize product listings, SEO, images, A+ Content, and backend keywords

• Coordinate inventory forecasting and replenishment planning

• Conduct competitor analysis and market research regularly

• Launch new products and manage ranking strategies

• Ensure account health and compliance with Amazon policies

• Create systems and SOPs to ensure scalable and repeatable processes

• Analyze KPIs, sales trends, TACOS, ACOS, conversion rates, and profitability

• Provide weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights

• Identify opportunities for expansion, bundling, and product improvements

• Develop long-term brand growth strategies aligned with revenue targets

• Coordinate with suppliers and operational teams when needed

• Stay updated with Amazon algorithm changes, trends, and best practices



EXPECTED RESULTS

• Consistent month-over-month revenue growth

• Increased profitability and operational efficiency

• Improved organic rankings and PPC performance

• Successful product launches and scaling initiatives

• Stable account health and listing performance

• Minimal need for owner involvement in daily operations

• Clear communication, reporting, and strategic transparency

• Strong brand positioning within the market



REQUIREMENTS

• Proven experience managing and scaling Amazon brands end-to-end

• At least 4–5 years of Amazon Seller Central management experience

• Strong expertise in Amazon US marketplace (CA/MX/EU experience is a plus)

• Advanced PPC management and scaling experience

• Experience managing supplement, wellness, health, or consumable brands is preferred

• Strong understanding of Amazon SEO, ranking, and listing optimization

• Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, Sellerboard, and similar tools

• Ability to independently make strategic decisions with minimal supervision

• Excellent reporting, communication, and project management skills

• Experience managing multiple departments/functions within Amazon operations

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to create and implement scalable systems and workflows

• Highly organized and results-driven



IDEAL PARTNER

We are looking for an agency that can:

• Operate as the brand’s dedicated Amazon growth team

• Take full ownership of the brand’s Amazon performance

• Require little to no daily involvement from us

• Deliver transparent reporting and strategic recommendations

• Scale the brand profitably and sustainably over time



To Apply Please provide:

• Company/Agency profile

• Case studies or Amazon brands previously managed

• Current brands/accounts under management

• Team structure and scope of services

• Pricing structure and preferred compensation model

• Expected KPIs and growth strategy approach

• Communication and reporting process



We are looking for a long-term strategic partner that can take Bisonbody to the next level with minimal owner involvement while maintaining full operational transparency and accountability.



COMPENSATION / AGENCY COMMISSION STRUCTURE

The average compensation structure for full-service Amazon brand management agencies typically falls under the following models:



Common Industry Standards

• Fixed Monthly Retainer: $3,000 – $15,000+ USD/month depending on scope and brand size

• Revenue Share / Commission Model: 5% – 15% of monthly Amazon sales

• Profit Share Model: 10% – 20% of net profits

• Hybrid Structure (Most Common):

• Lower monthly retainer + percentage of sales/profit growth



Recommended Setup for This Role

• For a fully hands-off partnership where the agency takes full ownership of operations and growth:

• 8% – 12% commission on total Amazon sales; OR

• 10% – 20% profit-sharing structure; PLUS optional performance bonuses tied to growth milestones



The final structure can be negotiated based on:

• Scope of services

• Ad spend management

• Team size allocated to the brand

• Existing revenue level

• Growth targets and expansion plans

This is not a strategy-only role. You will execute, optimize, and continuously improve SEO performance across multiple client accounts. You must be comfortable working inside real websites, solving real problems, and driving measurable results.



If you have successfully ranked businesses in industries such as HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, or similar service categories, and understand how Google Business Profiles, local pages, and service-area SEO truly drive leads; this role is built for you.



1. Core Responsibilities

A. On-Page SEO & Content Optimization

Optimize service pages, city/location pages, and blog content for local intent and conversions



Write or heavily edit SEO content (service pages, FAQs, blogs) that is clear, helpful, and conversion-focused



Implement proper heading structures (H1–H4), internal linking, schema, and strong CTAs



Align content with search intent, not just keyword placement



B. Technical SEO Execution

Perform full technical SEO audits and implement fixes, including:



Core Web Vitals optimization



Indexation and crawlability improvements



Site architecture and internal linking



Redirects, canonicalization, and noindex rules



Work directly within WordPress environments (including common builders)



Collaborate effectively with developers, you know exactly what to request and why



C. Local SEO (High Priority)

Fully optimize Google Business Profiles (categories, services, media, posts, FAQs)



Ensure citation consistency and NAP accuracy across platforms



Build and optimize city and service-area pages at scale



Apply a strong understanding of proximity, relevance, and prominence ranking factors



D. SOP Execution & Continuous Improvement

Execute established SEO SOPs with consistency and precision



Identify gaps and contribute to improving SOPs over time



Maintain strong task tracking, documentation, and accountability



E. Tools, Tracking & Reporting

Use SEO tools to monitor rankings, audits, and performance



Translate SEO data into clear, actionable insights for internal teams



Experience with Search Atlas is a strong advantage



2. Required Qualifications

A. Must-Have

5+ years of hands-on SEO experience (execution-focused)



Strong knowledge with tools such as BrightLocal, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog



Knowledge of schema markup for local/service businesses



Proven success ranking U.S.-based home services businesses



Strong expertise in both on-page and technical SEO



Practical experience working WordPress environments



Demonstrated experience with local SEO and Google Business Profiles



Process-driven mindset with ability to follow and improve SOPs



Strong written communication and documentation skills



B. Nice-to-Have (Pluses)



Agency experience managing multiple client accounts



Basic understanding of CRO for service-based websites



3. What Success Looks Like

Improved local rankings across service and city keywords



Increased qualified leads from organic and local search



Clean, scalable SEO implementations across multiple sites



Continuous improvement of SOPs and execution efficiency

title: Amazon Product Research and Development (Private Label)
description:
Job Title: Amazon Product Research and Development

Industry: Ecommerce / Private Label / Hair Care



Working Days: Monday to Friday

Shift Timings: EST Time Zone



JOB DESCRIPTION:

As an Amazon Product Research and Development, you will be pivotal in expanding our product catalog on the Amazon platform. You will be responsible for identifying commercially viable product ideas, managing the development process from concept to launch, and ensuring each product aligns with our brand identity while achieving profitability targets. This role requires a blend of analytical prowess, creative thinking, and a deep understanding of our customer avatar.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Conduct comprehensive product research and keyword analysis to identify high-demand products that align with our brand and customer needs.

• Collaborate with the sourcing and production team to manage the end-to-end product development process, ensuring clear processes and timely results.

• Work closely with our China-based sourcing agent to identify supplier options and oversee sampling using the Ignite framework.

• Negotiate pricing and terms with suppliers while maintaining a focus on win-win partnerships.

• Coordinate with freelance designers to create artwork and product designs as needed.

• Evaluate product samples for quality and functionality, ensuring adherence to specifications.

• Establish clear guidelines for product specifications and features, collaborating with the content team for packaging and listing creation.

• Monitor product workflow and deadlines, ensuring that products move through the development process efficiently.

• Validate product concepts through customer feedback and iterate based on insights gained.



EXPECTED RESULTS:

• Establish a product pipeline calendar for the next 12 months, facilitating strategic planning and manufacturing ramp-up.

• Development of products with potential for patent, trademark, or copyright protection to safeguard our brand from copycats.

• Meaningful product designs and features that resonate with our customer base.

• Clear understanding of capital requirements for product launches, supported by financial forecasts.

• Prediction of revenue growth from new products, enabling strategic decision-making for acquiring debt if necessary.

• Identify optimal factories for product manufacturing based on the variety of products in the pipeline.

• Validate new products through customer avatar feedback to ensure a high probability of success.

• Delivery of products that meet customer needs and elevate brand awareness.

• Development of intellectual property elements to defend against competitors.



REQUIREMENTS:

• Deep understanding of our customer avatar and their product preferences.

• Creative mindset with the ability to develop impactful product concepts.

• Strong organizational skills to manage multiple products in development simultaneously.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Proficiency in English, both spoken and written.

• Proficiency in tools such as Asana, Slack, Excel, Google Suite, Office, and Loom.

• Must be willing to work in the EST time zone and comfortable using a time tracker



Benefits: (Terms will be discussed during onboarding.)

• Leave Benefits

• Internet and Mobile Allowance

• Health and Dental Insurance

• Entertainment Benefits

• Trip Incentive (outside the country)



Note: This job description is not exhaustive, and additional activities, duties, or responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

title: Growth Operations & Business Development Executive
description:
We are hiring a Growth & Revenue Operations Consultant to serve as a strategic partner across a portfolio

of brands operating in the medical aesthetics and e-commerce sectors. This is a long-term, ongoing

engagement — not a one-time project. The successful candidate will work directly with founder-operators to

diagnose revenue leaks, build growth strategies, design pricing and membership architectures, and execute the

operational changes required to drive measurable revenue lift.



This role exists because we have learned the hard way that strategy decks without execution are worthless,

and execution without strategy wastes money. We need someone who delivers both — and stays accountable

to real numbers over real timeframes.



The brands you will work with operate in one or more of the following verticals:

• Medical aesthetics & luxury medical spas — injectables, laser, skincare treatments, memberships,

packages, retail product sales

• Direct-to-consumer e-commerce — skincare, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, and adjacent categories

• Service-based businesses with retail/e-commerce arms — hybrid models combining physical service

delivery with online product sales

• Multi-location and franchise-ready operations — businesses preparing to scale beyond single-location

This is a hybrid strategy + execution role. You will be expected to diagnose, design, and deliver. Slide decks

alone do not count as deliverables. We measure success by what shipped and what moved.



What You Will Own

• Full business diagnostics: financials, service revenue, expenses, marketing performance, client retention,

operational efficiency

• Revenue strategy: pricing architecture, package design, membership programs, retail mix, service

profitability analysis

• 30/60/90-day growth plans and 12-month revenue roadmaps with quantified targets

• KPI architecture: defining what to measure, how to measure it, dashboard design, weekly cadence

• Client journey optimization: lead capture ? consultation ? booking ? service ? upsell ? retention ?

referral

• Business development strategy for local partnerships, B2B pipelines, corporate wellness, and

influencer/creator collaborations

• Marketing operations oversight: campaign ROI review, channel allocation, cost-per-acquisition optimization

• Vendor and specialist coordination: directing CRM leads, web developers, content directors, and outreach

reps

• Weekly performance reporting and direct accountability to founder-operators



Required Skills & Experience

• Minimum 5 years of demonstrable experience in growth operations, revenue strategy, or business

development for service-based or e-commerce businesses

• Proven track record of measurable revenue lift across at least 3 prior clients or businesses (you will be

required to submit redacted case studies — see Application Requirements)

• Hands-on experience with pricing strategy, package design, and membership/recurring revenue programs

• KPI design and dashboard construction (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Airtable, or equivalent)

• Client journey mapping and conversion funnel optimization

• Sales pipeline architecture and lead follow-up systems

• CRM and marketing automation literacy (you do not need to build it — you must direct it competently)

• Project management and vendor/specialist coordination across remote teams

• Direct, accountable communication with founder-operators (no hand-holding required, no excuses tolerated)

• Comfort working with confidential financial data under NDA

Preferred Background

• Prior in-house or fractional experience with medical aesthetics, beauty, wellness, healthcare, or luxury

service businesses

• Direct experience scaling a founder-led service business from single-location to multi-location or franchise

model

• E-commerce growth experience (Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, or comparable)

• Working knowledge of GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, or comparable platforms

• Hands-on experience with at least one major booking platform (Vagaro, Jane App, Boulevard, Mangomint,

Zenoti, or AestheticsPro)

• Local SEO, Google Business Profile, and reputation management literacy

• Meta Ads and Google Ads strategic oversight (you do not run the ads — you evaluate them)

• Familiarity with HIPAA-adjacent data handling and compliance considerations in medical/aesthetic contexts

Tools & Platforms You Should Understand

You do not need to be expert in every platform listed below. You need to know what each one does, when to

use it, and how to direct the specialist who owns it. If more than 30% of these are unfamiliar, this role is likely

not a fit.

• CRM & Automation: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Keap, ActiveCampaign, 
, Zapier, n8n,

Twilio

• Booking & Operations: Vagaro, Jane App, Boulevard, Mangomint, Zenoti, AestheticsPro

• E-Commerce: Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Square

• Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Meta Business Suite

• Marketing Tools: Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Canva, Metricool, Later, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity

• Productivity: Notion, Airtable, ClickUp, Asana, Google Workspace, Slack, Loom

• Financial: QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe Dashboard, payment processor reporting



Initial Deliverables

• Full business diagnostic report covering revenue, operations, marketing, client journey, digital infrastructure,

and financials

• Top 10 revenue leaks identified with quantified dollar impact estimates

• Draft 30/60/90-day growth plan with weekly milestones

• Draft KPI dashboard with metrics, sources, and review cadence

• Recommended hiring sequence for any additional specialists needed

• Initial pricing, package, and membership recommendations with rationale

• Quick-win execution list: 5–10 items implementable within the first 30 days

Ongoing Deliverables

• Weekly written report covering wins, blockers, metrics, risks, and next priorities

• Monthly performance review tied to defined KPIs

• Quarterly strategic refresh and roadmap recalibration

• Continuous coordination of vendor and specialist team

• Documented SOPs for every system, workflow, and strategy put in place

• Loom walkthroughs for every major deliverable



Long-Term Opportunity

This is not a short-term gig. We are building long-term strategic capacity across multiple brands. The right

consultant can expect:

• Stable, ongoing engagement across multiple growing brands in adjacent verticals

• Direct access to founder-operators (no middle management layer)

• Opportunity to expand scope into Fractional CGO or Head of Growth role

• Equity participation or revenue-share structures for high-performers after demonstrated results

• Coordination authority over a remote team of specialists (CRM, web, brand, BD, conversion)

• First-look at additional consulting engagements as portfolio expands



Application Requirements — Read Carefully

1. Identity & Profile Verification

• Full name and verifiable LinkedIn profile (active, public, with documented work history)

• Resume or professional CV (PDF only, no Google Doc links)

• Time zone, working hours, and earliest start date

• Internet speed screenshot (minimum 50 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up) — required for remote execution roles

2. Required Portfolio Submissions (Non-Negotiable)

Submit redacted but verifiable evidence of at least three (3) prior engagements where you delivered

measurable revenue or operational impact. For each one, include:

• Business type, industry, and approximate revenue size at the time of engagement (revenue brackets

acceptable, e.g., $500K–$1M, $1M–$5M)

• The specific problem you were hired to solve

• Your scope of work and the strategies you designed

• What you actually executed or oversaw — not just what you recommended

• The measurable outcome with real numbers (revenue lift, CAC reduction, conversion rate improvement,

retention gains, etc.)

• The timeframe over which the results were achieved

• Screenshots, dashboard exports, or redacted documents that demonstrate the work (no documents = no

consideration)

Case studies without quantified outcomes will be discarded. Verbal claims of "helped grow the

business" are not acceptable. Show numbers, sources, and proof.

3. Required Video Introduction

Submit a Loom or video introduction (5–10 minutes maximum) covering, in this order:

• Who you are and your professional background

• The two engagements you are most proud of, and why

• Your typical diagnostic process when starting with a new brand

• How you d
 what to prioritize when a founder has 20 ideas and only 3 are worth doing

• Your communication style and how you handle pushback from founders

• Why you want this role specifically — not consulting in general

4. Sample Strategic Thinking Submission

Write a 300–500 word response to the following hypothetical scenario:

"A medical aesthetics business is doing $40,000/month in revenue with 60% margin. They have 200 active

clients but only 15% return for a second visit within 90 days. Their average ticket is $280. They run Meta Ads at

$3,200/month with a cost-per-lead of $42 and a lead-to-booking conversion of 18%. What three diagnostic

questions would you ask first, what would you suspect is the biggest revenue leak, and what would your first 30

days look like?"

We are looking for sharp diagnostic thinking, not generic consultant-speak. Show your reasoning.



Screening Questions

Answer each of the following in 3–5 sentences. Direct, specific answers only. Generic responses will be filtered

out.

1. How would you evaluate where a service-based business is losing money or opportunities in the first 14 days

of an engagement?

2. What KPIs would you track weekly for a luxury service business, and how would you prioritize them?

3. How would you d
 which services, packages, or memberships to promote over others?

4. Walk us through how you build a 30/60/90-day growth plan that founders actually execute.

5. How would you improve lead follow-up and booking conversion in a business where leads come in but never

get worked properly?

6. What is your approach to building local business development partnerships in a service category?

7. What reports or data would you request from a new client in week one, and why?

8. Describe a time you turned business data into a growth plan that shipped — with the actual outcome.

9. How do you stay accountable to measurable results when working remotely with founder-operators?

10. What is your approach when a founder has 20 ideas and only 3 are worth prioritizing right now?



How to Apply

Submit all of the following in a single application package:

• Resume / CV (PDF)

• LinkedIn profile URL

• Three (3) case studies with quantified outcomes (PDF)

• Loom or video introduction link (3–10 minutes)

• Sample strategic thinking submission (300–500 words)

• Two (2) verifiable client references

• Internet speed screenshot

• Stated availability and earliest start date

The first line of your application must read: REVENUE OPERATOR

Applications that do not begin with this keyword will not be reviewed. This is the first filter. We use it to identify

candidates who actually read the posting end-to-end.



Compensation Structure

This is a serious, performance-linked engagement. Compensation reflects the seniority and ownership level

required, and is structured collaboratively based on what each side brings to the table. We pay competitively for

the right person.

• Structure: Monthly retainer, hourly, or hybrid — open to discussion based on what works for both sides

• Rate: Competitive and reflective of senior-level expertise. We expect candidates to state their preferred

structure and rate in their application, supported by their track record

• Performance bonus: Available on top of base compensation, tied to documented revenue lift, KPI

achievement, or milestone delivery

• Initial term: 90-day engagement with quarterly renewal based on results

• Long-term opportunity: Equity-aligned partnership, fractional executive role, or expanded portfolio scope

available for the right candidate after demonstrated results

title: AI Search & Visibility Specialist (GEO + SEO)
description:
— This is NOT a traditional SEO role. Please read carefully before applying. —



About the Role

Search has fundamentally changed. Buyers no longer just Google — they ask ChatGPT, query Perplexity, and rely on Google AI Overviews to make decisions. At Calimingo Pools, a luxury pool design and construction company based in Southern California, we want to be the brand AI recommends when someone starts dreaming about their backyard.

We're hiring an AI Search & Visibility Specialist who lives at the intersection of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and traditional search. You understand how large language models retrieve, rank, and cite information — and you know how to get a brand into those answers. Traditional SEO is your foundation, not your ceiling.

This is a freelance, remote role with real ownership over how Calimingo is discovered across every search surface — from Google rankings to AI-generated responses.



?? Who This Role Is NOT For



Candidates who only know traditional SEO and have never worked with AI search platforms

Candidates who cannot name the difference between how Google indexes content vs. how an LLM retrieves and cites it

Candidates who have not actively used tools like Perplexity, ChatGPT, or Google AI Overviews as part of their professional work





What You'll Do



Own Calimingo's full search visibility strategy — from Google rankings to AI-generated answers

Conduct GEO and SEO audits covering AI discoverability, citation potential, technical health, and content structure

Optimize pages and content for LLM readability — answer-first formats, clear heading hierarchies, passage-level clarity that AI engines can extract and cite

Build topical authority and entity signals so both search engines and AI tools associate Calimingo with luxury pools, pool design, and outdoor living

Implement schema markup (FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization) for rich results and AI citation

Monitor and grow Calimingo's citation presence across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot, and Gemini

Pursue earned media placements — directories, review platforms, editorial features — that strengthen both backlinks and AI multi-source authority

Manage technical search fundamentals — crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, site architecture

Publish and maintain content directly on the Calimingo website via WordPress

Report monthly on organic rankings, AI citation frequency, and share of voice vs. competitors





Must-Have Skills



Hands-on GEO experience — you have actively worked to get brands cited in AI-generated answers, not just read about it

Working knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) — you understand why it matters for brand visibility

Fluency with AI platforms — you regularly use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and Gemini as professional tools, not just casually

AI visibility tracking — experience with tools like Otterly.ai, Ahrefs Brand Radar, BrightEdge, or similar

Traditional SEO foundation — keyword research, on-page optimization, link building, technical audits

Schema markup — FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization

Search tools — Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console

WordPress — confident navigating, editing, and publishing on a live website

Content strategy — semantic architecture, entity-based strategy, topical authority building





Nice to Have



Digital PR and earned media experience

Knowledge graph and E-E-A-T optimization

Familiarity with agentic search (OpenAI Operator) and agent-driven discovery

Experience with home improvement, construction, luxury goods, or lifestyle brands





To Apply, Please Answer These Questions

Applications without answers will not be reviewed.



Have you worked on a GEO strategy before? If yes, describe one specific result — ideally a brand you helped get cited in an AI-generated answer and how you did it.

What tools do you currently use to monitor AI citations and brand visibility across AI platforms?

What is RAG and why does it matter for a brand trying to appear in AI search answers?

What's one difference between optimizing content for Google vs. optimizing it for an LLM?





What Success Looks Like

Within 90 days: a comprehensive audit, a prioritized roadmap, and early improvements in how Calimingo appears in both Google results and AI-generated responses. Long term: Calimingo is the brand AI tools reach for when someone searches "luxury pool builders" or asks ChatGPT where to start.

title: Senior Amazon PPC and Listing Optimisation Strategist
description:
About Us



We are an established e-commerce business operating and growing brands on Amazon.



We have built strong internal capabilities across Amazon operations, advertising, listing optimisation, inventory management, and product launches. We are now looking for a senior Amazon specialist who can help us move beyond our current execution ceiling.



This is not a routine Amazon PPC management role.



We are looking to hire someone with deeper expertise, sharper commercial judgment, and exposure to newer tools, systems, and strategies that can bring our business to the next level.



The right person should be able to identify opportunities, risks, and knowledge gaps that our existing team may not yet recognise.



About the Role



You will take strategic ownership of Amazon PPC performance and listing optimisation across our portfolio.



Your responsibility is not simply to maintain campaigns or follow existing processes. You will be expected to assess our current approach, challenge assumptions, introduce stronger methodologies, and build a more advanced system for profitable growth.



You will work closely with the business owner and existing ecommerce team to strengthen our advertising and listing strategy.



Key Responsibilities



Amazon PPC Strategy

- Audit our existing Amazon advertising structure and identify major performance gaps

- Develop portfolio level PPC strategies across multiple products and ASINs

- Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant Amazon advertising formats

- Evaluate campaign performance beyond ACOS by considering TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

- Identify where advertising spend is creating waste, supporting organic ranking, defending the brand, acquiring customers, or accelerating product growth

- Improve keyword harvesting, search term management, campaign segmentation, bid management, budget allocation, and placement optimisation

- Establish clear campaign objectives based on the strategic role of each ASIN

- Build systems to monitor and optimise both high volume products and long tail products

- Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision making, efficiency, and performance

- Provide clear recommendations that translate data into business actions



Listing Optimisation

- Conduct detailed listing audits covering keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

- Improve product titles, bullet points, descriptions, search terms, images, and A Plus Content recommendations

- Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

- Develop testing plans for listing elements and measure the commercial impact of changes

- Work with copywriters and designers to produce stronger listing assets

- Ensure that listing optimisation and PPC strategy support one another



Systems and Leadership

- Build stronger frameworks, scorecards, dashboards, and operating procedures for Amazon advertising and listing optimisation

- Train and upskill existing tea
mbers

- Explain complex findings clearly to management and recommend priorities

- Identify areas where our existing processes, tools, or assumptions may be limiting growth

- Take ownership of execution without requiring constant direction or close supervision

- Keep the company updated on important developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and ecommerce technology



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



- At least five years of strong Amazon marketplace experience

- Advanced hands on experience managing Amazon PPC for established brands or large product portfolios

- Demonstrated success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and advertising efficiency

- Strong expertise in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

- Experience working with accounts that have multiple ASINs and complex campaign structures

- Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, inventory, and return on advertising investment

- Experience using advanced Amazon advertising and analytics tools

- Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

- The ability to identify problems and opportunities that are not immediately obvious

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong ownership, initiative, analytical thinking, and attention to detail

- Strong Advantages



It would be highly advantageous if you have experience with:



1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio level budget allocation

9. AI assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



Who Will Succeed in This Role



You will likely succeed if you are someone who:



1. Thinks beyond standard PPC metrics

2. Can distinguish between tactical improvements and strategic opportunities

3. Is comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

4. Can explain what should change, why it should change, and how it should be implemented

5. Brings structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

6. Continues learning and remains current with Amazon platform developments

7. Wants to influence business strategy rather than simply complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids, downloads reports, or follows standard operating procedures.



We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



Working days and hours:

• Full-time basis – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

• Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

• 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



Application Instructions:

Please submit your application with the following (applications without these will be less considered):

• Your CV/Resume.

• A short video introduction of yourself and why you’re a good fit.

• A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

• Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

• The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

• Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application.

title: Creative Team Leader
description:
Job Post: AI Creative Operations Manager

Position: AI Creative Operations Manager / Technical Team Lead

Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time after a successful paid pilot

Paid Pilot: 2 weeks — 800 USD flat project fee

Full-Time Compensation: $1,500–$2,500 USD per month to start, depending on experience, with room for growth



Company: Rudderr LLC



This position is designed as a senior systems-builder and quality-control leader, not a general virtual assistant or entry-level graphic designer. The manager will build and operate a scalable AI-assisted content team, recruit and train junior editors, create repeatable workflows, and enforce strict product-accuracy standards.



About Rudderr



Rudderr is an e-commerce brand management and wholesale growth company that helps consumer brands expand across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Faire, and social media.

We manage products across several categories, including outdoor and survival gear, home improvement, lawn and garden, wellness, beauty, and specialty consumer products.

We are building an internal AI-assisted content production operation capable of producing high-quality product lifestyle images, short-form videos, and UGC-style content at scale.



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced AI Creative Operations Manager to build, lead, and manage our Philippines-based content production team.

You will not be expected to create every image or video yourself. Your primary responsibility will be to build the people, systems, workflows, and quality-control process required to deliver accurate, realistic, and premium e-commerce content consistently.

You will receive original product photography and creative direction from our U.S. team. You will then manage a team of junior AI image and video editors who transform those product photos into realistic lifestyle scenes, advertising assets, social media content, and short-form videos.



Our most important standard is product fidelity. Logos, dimensions, materials, colors, proportions, accessories, controls, textures, and product features must remain accurate. Product distortion, invented features, incorrect branding, and visibly artificial imagery must be caught and corrected before delivery.



Primary Responsibilities

Build and Manage the Creative Team

• Recruit and evaluate junior AI image editors, video editors, and creative production contractors.

• Handle onboarding, training, performance reviews, coaching, and replacement of underperforming tea
mbers.

• Maintain sufficient staffing so content production does not stop when an editor becomes unavailable.

• Assign work based on each editor’s skills, availability, and performance.

• Build a reliable team capable of increasing or decreasing production based on demand.

 

Build the Content Production System

• Create repeatable workflows for AI-assisted product photography, lifestyle imagery, video, and synthetic UGC.

• Develop SOPs, templates, prompt libraries, brand guidelines, file-naming systems, and quality-control checklists.

• Establish a clear process from receiving original product photos through final asset approval.

• Organize project files, source images, masks, models, prompts, revisions, and final exports.

• Improve production speed without sacrificing product accuracy or visual quality.

• Work toward a typical delivery time of approximately 24–48 hours for standard content requests.

 

Own Quality Control

• Review every asset before it reaches the U.S. team.

• Enforce a zero-tolerance standard for distorted products, altered logos, incorrect colors, missing accessories, unrealistic shadows, and inconsistent proportions.

• Check perspective, lighting direction, contact shadows, reflections, scale, resolution, texture, anatomy, and environmental realism.

• Identify whether an asset can be corrected through inpainting, masking, compositing, relighting, regeneration, or manual Photoshop editing.

• Train junior editors to recognize common AI generation errors.

• Maintain consistency across image collections, recurring virtual models, brand campaigns, and product variations.



Manage AI Image and Video Production

• Oversee the creation of realistic lifestyle scenes using original product photography.

• Ensure that the actual product remains accurate while environments, backgrounds, people, and scenarios are generated or composited around it.

• Direct the creation of outdoor, camping, water-sports, home, wellness, and other product-specific lifestyle scenarios.

• Manage short-form video production using still product images, generated environments, motion effects, and AI video tools.

• Develop recurring virtual creators or product experts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, advertising, and educational content.

• Ensure temporal consistency so products remain sharp and stable while backgrounds or surrounding elements move naturally.

 

Manage Performance and Communication

• Serve as the primary point of contact between Rudderr and the creative production team.

• Translate creative requests into clear assignments for junior editors.

• Track production volume, revision rates, approval rates, turnaround time, and editor performance.

• Provide regular updates on project status, staffing, bottlenecks, and tool requirements.

• Recommend workflow, staffing, and software improvements based on measurable results.

• Manage software access and ensure company assets, trained models, and workflows remain organized and secure.

The operational model including manager ownership of recruiting, onboarding, training, performance management, production continuity, and final quality is central to this position.



Required Experience

• At least 1 years of experience managing a creative, multimedia, design, post-production, or digital content team.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce product photography and lifestyle content.

• Advanced ability to review and correct AI-generated images.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, branding, visual realism, and fine details.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a computer capable of managing professional image and video workflows.

• Ability to work independently, make decisions, and communicate problems before they affect deadlines.



Preferred Technical Experience

Strong candidates should have hands-on experience with several AI generating tool and programs





Helpful Additional Experience

• Outdoor, survival, camping, water-sports, home-improvement, or consumer-product brands

• Managing freelance or offshore production teams

• Creating content for multiple brands at the same time

• Developing recurring virtual models or AI-generated brand ambassadors

• Capacity planning and creative production budgeting

 

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 30–60 days, the successful candidate will have:

• Recruited and evaluated a dependable group of junior editors.

• Established clear production and quality-control SOPs.

• Created a dependable workflow for receiving, producing, reviewing, revising, and delivering assets.

• Reduced preventable revisions caused by product distortion or overlooked AI defects.

• Built a consistent pipeline for realistic product lifestyle imagery.

• Established measurable expectations for turnaround time, asset quality, and editor performance.

• Begun expanding the operation into video and UGC-style content.

 

Two-Week Paid Pilot

Canidates will begin with a paid two-week project.

During the pilot, the candidate will be asked to:

• Source and evaluate two to three potential junior editors.

• Provide clear creative assignments using several test product photographs.

• Direct the editors in creating distinct lifestyle-image concepts.

• Develop a short-form video concept for each test product.

• Review AI-generated images and identify product, lighting, anatomy, perspective, and realism problems.

• Demonstrate how they would organize the workflow, manage revisions, and approve final assets.

• Present a proposed team structure, production process, and quality-control checklist.

The purpose of the pilot is not to determine whether the manager can personally create every asset. It is intended to evaluate the candidate’s ability to find talent, communicate standards, build systems, manage production, and prevent defective work from reaching the client.

Junior editor expenses approved for the pilot or ongoing operation will be managed under a separate company-funded production budget and will not be deducted from the manager’s compensation.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. Your resume and LinkedIn profile to 
 A brief description of the largest creative or production team you have managed.

3. Examples of e-commerce images, videos, AI workflows, or creative projects you personally managed or quality-checked.

title: 3D Modeling/CAD Designer
description:
Speed Industries is looking for a skilled Virtual Assistant with strong 3D modeling and CAD design experience to support our fabrication, laser cutting, powder coating, and product development work.



This role is ideal for someone who understands manufacturing, can take rough ideas or marked-up drawings and turn them into clean, usable CAD files, and can help reduce the design workload for our internal team. The right person will be detail-oriented, organized, responsive, and comfortable working remotely with a fast-moving fabrication company.



The primary focus of this position will be creating, revising, and preparing 3D models, 2D drawings, flat patterns, and production-ready design files for manufacturing.



Key Responsibilities

3D Modeling & CAD Design



Create and revise 3D models for fabricated parts, assemblies, brackets, guards, frames, fixtures, signs, and customer products.



Develop CAD models from sketches, photos, measurements, customer drawings, or verbal direction.



Prepare clean and accurate part files for CNC laser cutting, tube laser cutting, press brake forming, welding, and powder coating.



Create and update 2D drawings with dimensions, notes, material callouts, bend details, hole sizes, tolerances, and revision history.



Generate flat patterns, DXF files, STEP files, PDF drawings, and other required production files.



Assist with converting customer-supplied files into usable manufacturing drawings.



Check designs for manufacturability, including bend allowances, material thickness, hole spacing, weld access, hardware clearance, and powder coating considerations.



Drawing Packages & Revisions



Prepare professional drawing packages for shop use and customer approval.



Revise existing drawings based on feedback from customers, shop employees, or management.



Maintain organized file naming, folder structure, and version control.



Clearly mark changes and communicate revision updates.



Help standardize Speed Fabrication’s drawing templates, title blocks, notes, and CAD file organization.



Manufacturing Support



Work with Speed Fabrication’s team to help translate ideas into buildable products.



Support laser cutting, fabrication, and powder coating projects with accurate CAD files.



Assist with product development for online products, Shopify items, Etsy products, customer jobs, and repeat manufacturing work.



Identify potential design issues before parts reach the shop floor.



Help create repeatable designs that improve efficiency and reduce rework.



Required Skills



Strong experience with 3D CAD software such as:



Fusion 360

SolidWorks

Inventor

AutoCAD

Onshape

or similar professional CAD software



Ability to create accurate 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings.



Ability to export DXF, STEP, PDF, STL, and other common file types.



Understanding of sheet metal design, bend lines, flat patterns, material thickness, and formed parts.



Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.



Strong attention to detail.



Good written communication skills.



Ability to follow directions, ask smart questions, and work independently.



Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely.



Ability to organize files clearly and consistently.



Preferred Experience



Experience designing parts for CNC laser cutting.



Experience with press brake forming and sheet metal fabrication.



Experience with tube laser or structural fabrication.



Experience creating weldment drawings or fabrication assemblies.



Experience designing products for powder coating.



Experience working with American units: inches, fractions, decimals, gauges, and material thicknesses.



Experience creating customer approval drawings.



Experience with manufacturing businesses, job shops, or custom fabrication companies.



Basic understanding of hardware, fasteners, weld symbols, tabs, slots, bend reliefs, and tolerances.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is not just a CAD operator. They are someone who thinks through how a part will actually be made.



They should be able to take an idea like, “We need a bracket that bolts here and holds this panel,” and turn it into a clean model and drawing that the shop can manufacture with minimal back-and-forth.



They should be organized, responsive, and capable of working with limited information while still knowing when to ask questions.



Typical Projects



Examples of work may include:



Sheet metal brackets

Laser-cut parts

Welded assemblies

Guards and covers

Custom signs

Product prototypes

Customer-supplied drawing cleanup

DXF file preparation

Fixtures and shop tooling

Repeat manufacturing parts

Assembly drawings

Flat patterns for laser cutting and bending

Software Requirements



Candidate should have access to professional CAD software or be willing to work within Speed Fabrication’s preferred CAD workflow.



Preferred software: Fusion 360, but other platforms may be acceptable depending on experience and file compatibility.



Required export formats:



DXF

STEP

PDF

STL when needed

Native CAD files when applicable

Communication & Workflow



This is a remote position. Communication may happen through
, phone, text, shared folders, project management software, or video calls.



The candidate must be able to:



Review project instructions

Ask clarifying questions

Provide estimated completion times

Submit clean files

Make revisions quickly

Keep files organized

Communicate when something is unclear or not manufacturable

Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, speed, accuracy, and ability to produce manufacturing-ready work.



Possible structures include:



Hourly

Per project

Part-time contract

Trial period with growth potential

Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



Accuracy of CAD models and drawings

Speed of turnaround

Low number of revision errors

Clear communication

Ability to understand fabrication requirements

Clean file organization

Ability to reduce workload from Speed Fabrication’s internal team

Ability to create files that can move directly into production
