Role Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented Construction Administrator to support the commercial and procurement  functions of our residential housing developments.



The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing supplier invoices, verifying delivery dockets, checking quantities and rates, maintaining purchasing records,  and ensuring that materials and subcontractor costs are correctly charged to projects before payment approval.



The role is critical  in ensuring cost control, preventing overcharging,  and maintaining accurate project expenditure records across multiple residential construction sites.



Key Responsibilities



Invoice Verification

•   Review all supplier invoices before payment approval.

•   Match invoices against delivery dockets and purchase orders.

•   Verify that quantities  invoiced match quantities  delivered.

•   Confirm that invoiced rates match agreed supplier pricing.

•   Identify discrepancies and query suppliers where necessary.

•   Maintain records of approved and disputed  invoices.



Delivery Docket Management

•   Collect delivery dockets from site managers and site teams.

•   Ensure all deliveries are supported  by signed delivery dockets.

•   Verify that materials delivered correspond with invoiced materials.

•   Organise  and file delivery records by project and supplier.

•   Maintain digital records of all delivery documentation.

•   Assist management in controlling purchasing costs.

•   Produce reports on material expenditure and supplier performance.

•   Verify completed works against approved valuations.

•   Maintain records of subcontractor contracts and rates. 



BCAR Document Control

compliance.

• Obtain certificates, inspection records, test reports, product certifications, CE documentation, and Declarations of Performance (DoPs) from site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and consultants.

• Ensure all compliance documentation is filed within the correct project and dwelling folders.

• Assist the Assigned Certifier, Architect,  and Engineers  by providing requested documentation during inspections and at project completion.

• Prepare and maintain dwelling handover files and completion packs to support smooth project certification and handover.



General Administration

•   Maintain organised  digital filing systems.

•   Assist project managers and quantity surveyors with administration tasks.

•   Support procurement  and commercial teams with record keeping.

Requirements

Essential

•   Excellent attention to detail.

•   Strong numerical ability.

•   Advanced  Microsoft Excel skills.

•   Experience reviewing invoices and financial records.

•   Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Email Specialist
description:
The Mission: We are a fast-growing Direct Response E-Commerce brand. We don’t care about “brand awareness” or fluffy newsletters. We care about one thing: Conversion.



Your sole mission is to maximize our Average Order Value (AOV) and recover lost revenue by crafting high-converting, direct-response
 campaigns. You will own our backend monetization: Post-Purchase Upsell Flows, Abandoned Checkout Sequences, and VIP Customer Promotions.



The Role & System Rules:



Direct Response Copywriting: You write punchy, benefit-driven copy at or below a 6th-grade reading level. No complex jargon, no long paragraphs.

Upsell Architecture: You understand that e-commerce upsells require minimal copy. You focus on a strong headline, an attractive product hero image, short high-impact copy (focusing on value/discount), and a bold, frictionless CTA.

Visual Design Execution: You have the basic design skills to assemble these
s. You know how to pair your copy with striking, native-looking product images or GIFs that command attention and drive clicks.

Speed & Iteration: You test subject lines, angles, and CTAs systematically. You cut losers quickly and double down on winners.



What We Expect From You:



You understand the psychology of buying (Desire, Belief, Urgency, Scarcity, Risk Reversal).

You know how to frame an upsell as the "next logical step" (e.g., selling a complimentary product that solves the next phase of the customer's problem).

You don't need a manager to tell you what to do. You are an operator who looks at the data (Revenue, Click-Through-Rate, EPC) and optimizes relentlessly.

???? MANDATORY APPLICATION TEST (Do NOT apply without answering this)



We hire based on performance, not resumes. To be considered for this position, you must complete this quick, 5-minute test at the top of your application. If you fail to include this, your application will be instantly deleted.



The Scenario: A customer just purchased our flagship "EMS Foot Massager" (Front-End Product) designed to relieve foot pain and neuropathy. We need a Post-Purchase Upsell
 sent 10 minutes after their purchase to sell them our "Detoxifying Herbal Foot Patches" (Complimentary Upsell Product / Consumable).



Your Task (Provide this in your application):



Subject Line: Write 1 curiosity-driven or benefit-driven subject line.

Headline: Write the main
 headline (max 8 words).

The Copy: Write 2-3 short, punchy sentences selling the foot patches as the ultimate complimentary addition to their massager. Focus on impulse-buy psychology, the "next logical step" to draw out toxins/relieve pain, and a limited-time discount.

Visual Directive: Describe in 1-2 sentences what the Hero Image of this
 should look like to maximize clicks.

CTA: What exactly does the button say?

title: Become a RAY - Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
Up to $1,000 USD/month + Up to 3 Months Bonus + 10% Raise at 3 Months Remote | Full-Time | EU Hours – No Graveyard Shifts 



ABOUT RAY AI 

RAY AI is not a staffing platform. We are not a marketplace. We are an elite executive support company that matches exceptional remote assistants with high-performing founders and investors across Europe and the US. We screen over 120,000 applicants every year. Fewer than 40 become RAYs. 



Our clients are demanding because their work matters. As a RAY, you are part of a global team – every month, all RAYs connect on a RAY Connect call for community, peer learning, and mutual support. Here is what our clients say: 



“Jadon enables me to process work faster while also increasing accuracy. He has been very valuable in my day-to-day.”  – Frederich Jost, Founder & CEO, Holy Energy 

Jadon | RAY AI Executive Partner | BSc Actuarial Science & Statistics – prior experience as a financial advisor 



“We would not be able to operate with the same level of structure and efficiency without Daniela’s support. The value she brings is significant and directly impacts how Green Horizon Partners functions day to day.”  – Jan Ripken, Co-founder & Managing Partner, Green Horizon Partners 

Daniela | RAY AI Executive Partner | Bachelor’s in English – transitioned from a career in education 



One of our RAYs joined as an Executive Assistant. Within twelve months, they were promoted to AI Project Manager. Our longest-serving RAY has been with their client for nearly two years.



WHAT YOU WILL DO 

As a RAY, you are your client’s most trusted operational partner. This goes far beyond traditional EA work – you build automations, produce financial reports, conduct research, and lead projects that improve how your client’s business operates structurally. 

Manage your client's inbox, calendar, travel, and tasks – end to end, without supervision 

Build and maintain AI-powered automations and workflows using Claude, ChatGPT, Zapier, N8N, and Notion – tools you are trained on before your first client match 

Conduct research and produce polished reports for investor meetings, board presentations, and strategic decisions 

Handle financial reporting, expense management, and accounting preparation 

Lead long-horizon projects that improve how your client's business runs structurally 

Anticipate your client's needs before they arise – if they have to ask you twice, something has gone wrong 



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR 

We hire from two pathways – both produce exceptional RAYs: 

- Professionals with direct experience supporting a senior executive, founder, or client in an administrative or operational capacity 

- Technically fluent candidates from AI, operations, or systems backgrounds who are highly proficient in English and demonstrate the high agency the role requires 



For both pathways, the non-negotiables are: 

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent – firm requirement 

- C2-level English, written and spoken – assessed, not assumed 

- High agency – you act without being told, take ownership of outcomes, and bring solutions. Tested directly. 

- Genuine curiosity about AI tools – RAY provides full training, but you need to be the person who experiments and builds 

- Full-time availability, 40 hours per week, aligned to European client hours 

- Discretion – your client will trust you with sensitive information from week one 



WORKING HOURS 

We prioritise matching Philippines-based RAYs with European clients. This means most of our Philippines team works mid-to-late evening rather than graveyard hours. No overnight shifts. A real schedule you can build a life around. Your specific schedule is confirmed during the matching process. 



WHAT YOU EARN AND RECEIVE 

- Monthly salary: up to $1,000 USD – paid reliably every month as an independent contractor 

- Performance bonus: up to 3 additional months’ salary per year. Every RAY who has hit their performance markers has received a bonus. 

- 10% salary raise at 3 months: performance-gated, and 95% of our RAYs earn it. Your earnings increase within your first quarter. 

- Company laptop and hardware: fully provided – you do not spend anything on equipment 

- 4-week paid training bootcamp: Week 1: operational excellence. Week 2: AI and LLMs. Week 3: modern productivity tools. Week 4: the RAY standard – all before your first client match

- German language classes: fully sponsored by RAY AI for tea
mbers working with German-speaking clients 

- Expert community: every RAY has access to automation engineers, presentation designers, and language specialists 

- RAY Connect: a monthly community call for all RAYs – peer support, shared learning, and a team that has your back from day one 

- Career progression: one of our RAYs was promoted from Executive Assistant to AI Project Manager within twelve months 



OUR PROCESS 

1. Application 

2. Skills and English assessment 

3. Interview with our team 

4. Case study 

5. Final interview with our founders 

6. Offer and onboarding 

The process takes 2–3 weeks from application to offer. We will never ask you to pay any fee at any stage – not for training, equipment, or onboarding. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp only. 



READY TO APPLY? 

RAY AI is where the most talented remote professionals in the Philippines build careers that match their ability – working with world-class clients, earning USD, growing in an AI-first environment.

title: Underwriting Technician
description:
PLEASE APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK:


/apply-job-1



About Us:

With over 100 years of combined industry experience, the Community Minerals team specializes in the purchase of mineral or royalty rights all over the US. We have earned a stellar reputation with hundreds of satisfied customers and an “A” rating with the Better Business Bureau. With our proven track record, we continue to serve mineral owners in several states with transparency, accountability, and a personalized experience to meet individual needs.



Job Summary:

The Underwriting Technician supports the Underwriting Team by managing data entry, documentation preparation, and technical file organization for acquisition evaluations. The role ensures that all inputs required by Underwriters are accurate, complete, and delivered in a timely and compliant manner. This position directly contributes to the operational efficiency of the Reserves and Underwriting Closing Teams by handling structured, detail-oriented tasks that enable faster deal turnaround and technical standardization.



What You'll Do:

• Parse, clean, and organize production and well data from internal and third-party sources, including API numbers and well names.

• Enter data into Excel spreadsheets and designated systems following standardized formats and naming conventions.

• Verify the completeness and accuracy of submitted data to ensure readiness for underwriting evaluations.

• Identify and resolve data discrepancies in collaboration with Underwriters and other tea
mbers.

• Prepare, organize, and maintain technical documentation such as regulatory filings, public records, and broker materials.

• Support evaluation workflows by setting up deal folders and ensuring required data inputs are complete.

• Track incoming and outgoing evaluation documentation for internal and marketed deals.

• Collaborate with the Reserves Team to support standardization of evaluation processes and inputs.

• Assist the Underwriting Closing Team by organizing final documentation and verifying data files for completeness.

• Maintain digital records related to API numbers, mineral rights, and property documentation.

• Follow established quality control protocols and contribute to process consistency across the team.

• Provide operational support for tools, templates, and documentation workflows.

• Identify recurring data challenges and suggest basic improvements to templates or formatting practices.

• Adhere to internal policies and documentation standards to ensure compliance with industry requirements.



What We're Looking For:

• Bachelor’s degree or college-level coursework in Petroleum Engineering, Geosciences, Energy Studies, Information Management, or a related field (equivalent experience may be considered).

• Minimum 1–2 years of experience in data entry, technical documentation, or administrative support within a technical or energy-related environment.



Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (sorting, formatting, formulas, and basic data validation).

• Familiarity with large dataset handling, template-driven documentation, and digital file organization.

• Knowledge of oil and gas production data, well naming conventions, and API identifiers is an advantage.

• Comfortable using digital file systems, shared folders, and version-controlled workspaces.



Soft Skills:

• High attention to detail and consistency in data handling.

• Strong organizational and time management skills.

• Clear written and verbal communication.

• Ability to collaborate with cross-functional tea
mbers remotely.

• Dependable, responsive, and structured in task execution.



Industry Knowledge:

• Basic understanding of oil and gas production workflows and mineral acquisition data.

• Familiarity with mineral rights, well structures, or technical records is a plus.

• Awareness of regulatory standards for documentation in the energy or mineral sectors is beneficial.



Competencies and Attributes:

• Thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first work environment.

• Demonstrates discipline, focus, and reliability in support tasks.

• Aligns with the team’s emphasis on operational excellence, compliance, and support for technical evaluation.

• Open to collaboration, feedback, and process alignment across teams.



What’s in it for you:

• Competitive Compensation: Earn $3.18 - $3.55 per hour. paid in U.S. Dollars, commensurate with your skills and experience.

• Work your way: Remote Work Set-Up enabling you to operate from the comfort and convenience of your own chosen workspace

• Success Incentives: Enjoy company bonuses and performance-driven rewards.

• Soar with Us: Opportunities for career growth and promotions await you.

• Positive Vibes Only: Experience a supportive and uplifting work culture.

• Annual Bonus: We value your dedication throughout the year, rewarding you with an annual performance bonus shared at the end of the year.

• Performance Raise: Your hard work doesn't go unnoticed. Be ready to seize opportunities for salary increase based on your outstanding performance.

• Performance Incentives: We believe exceptional work deserves recognition. Performance incentives are awarded to individuals who demonstrate outstanding contributions, initiative, and results. It’s our way of celebrating excellence and motivating continued success.

• Discretionary Bonus: At Community Minerals, exceptional work doesn’t go unnoticed. Contractors who consistently go above and beyond may be rewarded with discretionary bonuses, a token of appreciation for outstanding contributions, impactful results, and dedication to excellence. Let your work speak, and the rewards will follow!



Other Requirements:

• Willing to work in US Business Hours (CST)

• Must have stable Internet and Power Connection



System Requirements:

To ensure optimal performance and functionality while using different web and application tools, please make sure that your syste
ets the following requirements:



Operating System:

• Windows: Windows 10 (64-bit) or higher

- macOS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or higher



Processor:

• Intel: 8th Gen Core i3, i5, i7, or newer

• AMD: Ryzen 3 (2018) or newer



Memory (RAM):

• A minimum of 8 GB of RAM is required.

• Recommended: 16 GB RAM for multitasking and optimal performance

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) Sourcing & Sales Tracking Specialist
description:
We are a growing Amazon e-commerce company looking for an experienced, highly analytical, and data-driven Online Arbitrage (OA) Sourcing Virtual Assistant.



Your primary responsibility will be to find highly profitable products from online retail stores and marketplaces that we can flip on Amazon. Additionally, you will be responsible for daily data entry, managing spreadsheets to track our ongoing sales, calculating exact profit margins, and monitoring inventory levels.



If you love digging into data, are a master at spreadsheet formulas, and know how to find winning OA products, we want to talk to you!



Key Responsibilities:

Online Arbitrage Sourcing: Actively find profitable deals using manual sourcing methods and automated scanning tools across various US retail websites.



Keepa & Data Analysis: Analyze Keepa charts deeply to check sales velocity, buy box history, price stability, and competitor stock levels to ensure low-risk purchasing.



Sales & Profit Tracking: Maintain and meticulously update daily spreadsheets tracking units sold, gross sales, Amazon fees, cost of goods sold (COGS), and net profit.



Inventory & Buy Box Monitoring: Keep track of existing inventory levels, alert us when items need restocking, and monitor our active listings for competitive pricing changes.



IP & Restriction Verification: Confirm that products are not gated and have no history of Intellectual Property (IP) complaints or brand restrictions.



Strict Data Security & Confidentiality (Non-Negotiable):

?? Zero-Tolerance Policy: All product leads, sourcing strategies, daily sales data, and spreadsheet access are strictly confidential and the exclusive property of our company. Sharing any of our spreadsheets, tracking links, or product leads with other VAs, external networks, or third parties is strictly prohibited. Any violation of this policy is a breach of trust and constitutes grounds for immediate dismissal without warning.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience specifically in Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) sourcing and e-commerce tracking.



Tools: Highly proficient with Keepa, Seller Central, and OA sourcing tools (e.g., Tactical Arbitrage, Source Mogul, or SellerAmp SAS).



Spreadsheet Expert: Advanced skills in Google Sheets and MS Excel. You must be comfortable working with formulas, filtering massive amounts of data, and keeping tracking sheets perfectly organized.



Hardware & Technical Setup:



Computer: A modern, fast computer with at least 8GB of RAM (16GB preferred) that can handle multiple active browser extensions and massive data sheets without lagging.



Internet: A stable, high-speed wired internet connection (DSL, Cable, or Fiber) with a minimum speed of 20 Mbps. Note: Mobile hotspots/satellite internet are not accepted due to reliability concerns.



Backup: A reliable backup plan for internet/power outages to ensure daily sales tracking is never missed.



What We Offer:

Competitive salary based on experience (paid weekly).



Performance-based bonuses tied directly to the profitability of your product finds.



Clear guidelines, structured workflows, and a supportive working environment.



Full-time, long-term career growth potential.



How to Apply:

To apply, please reply to this post with the subject line: "I am your next OA Sourcing & Tracking Expert - [Your Name]" and include the following:



A brief summary of your experience sourcing for Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA).



Which specific OA tools and browser extensions you use daily.



A screenshot of a Keepa chart you analyzed recently, with a 2-sentence explanation of why it is a winning OA product.



A brief description of your current work setup (PC specs, internet provider, and connection speed).



Confirm that you have read and agree to our strict Zero-Tolerance data security policy regarding tracking sheets and leads.



Your desired monthly salary for a full-time position.



Applications missing the correct subject line or any of the requested answers will be automatically disqualified.

title: International Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Coffee Export Business
description:

We are looking for a proactive **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to help us build and qualify international B2B buyer opportunities.



---

## Role Overview



Your main responsibility is to find, research, and qualify **importers, distributors, and wholesale buyers** who can purchase and distribute coffee products in their local markets.



This is not a data entry or marketing role — this is a **sales-focused lead generation role**.



---

## Target Markets



Focus on finding buyers in:



* Africa (e.g. Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya)

* Asia (e.g. Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam)

* South America (e.g. Chile, Colombia, Peru)



---

## Target Companies



You will focus on finding:



* Coffee importers

* FMCG distributors

* Food & beverage wholesalers

* Supermarket supply distributors

* Hotel & restaurant suppliers (HoReCa sector)

* Office coffee suppliers



---

## LinkedIn Responsibilities (VERY IMPORTANT)



LinkedIn is a core sales channel for this role.



You will:



* Use LinkedIn to identify importers, distributors, and decision makers

* Send connection requests to relevant business contacts

* Send direct outreach messages to initiate conversations

* Follow up with leads and manage conversations

* Track all LinkedIn activity in a structured spreadsheet or CRM

* Support optimization of the founder’s LinkedIn profile for B2B credibility



The goal of LinkedIn work is ONLY to generate real business conversations and meetings.



---

## Responsibilities (Overall)



* Research international B2B buyers using Google, LinkedIn, and directories

* Identify decision makers (Import Managers, Purchasing Managers, Owners, Category Managers)

* Collect verified contact information 
, phone, LinkedIn)

* Qualify leads based on distribution capability and import activity

* Organize all leads in Google Sheets

* Rank leads based on priority (High / Medium / Low potential)

* Write short reasoning why each lead is relevant



---

##  Required Output Per Lead



* Company Name

* Country

* Website

* Industry / Category

* Decision Maker Name

* Decision Maker Role

*

* LinkedIn Profile

* Phone (if available)

* Lead Quality (High / Medium / Low)

* Notes (why this company is relevant)



---

## Key Objective



Build a list of **high-quality, sales-ready importers and distributors** that are capable of:



* Importing coffee products

* Distributing to retail, horeca, or wholesale channels

* Purchasing in bulk quantities



Quality is more important than quantity.



---

## Required Skills



* B2B Lead Generation experience

* LinkedIn Sales experience (outreach, not posting)

* Market / Prospect Research experience

* Strong English communication

* Google Sheets / Excel proficiency

* Attention to detail

* Ability to identify real business opportunities (not just data collection)



---

## Preferred Experience



* Experience in export/import or FMCG industries

* Experience working as SDR or Business Development Assistant

* Familiarity with coffee, food, or beverage industries



---

## What Success Looks Like



* You find **qualified importers, not random companies**

* You start real conversations with buyers

* Leads are ready for direct outreach and follow-up

* Each lead includes decision-maker contact details

* Leads are ranked by potential value

* Work directly contributes to sales opportunities



---

## Work Type



* Full-time or part-time flexible

* Long-term role if performance is strong



---

## Compensation



Please include:



* Your hourly rate or monthly salary expectation

* Previous experience in lead generation or SDR roles



---

## About Us



We are building a global distribution network for premium coffee products and are actively expanding into emerging markets with strong import demand.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building websites, landing pages, and marketing funnels that not only look great but also generate leads and sales.



You will work directly with the owner, Nathan, helping create websites and landing pages for businesses across the United States. Most projects will involve Duda websites, Google Ads landing pages, Meta Ads landing pages, Perspective funnels, and GoHighLevel funnels.



As the agency grows, bonuses will be paid on top of wages. When we win, we want our team to win too.



COMPANY



Murray Marketing Services LLC

(USA | Remote)



ABOUT US



Launched in 2021 and based in Knoxville, Tennessee, Murray Marketing Services is a growing digital marketing agency that helps service-based businesses generate leads through Google Ads, Meta Ads, websites, SEO,
 marketing, and marketing automation.



We work with businesses across many industries including healthcare, home services, professional services, contractors, financial services, and more.

WHY JOIN US?



Creative Work

Work directly with the founder and help shape the future of a growing agency.



Skill Growth

Flexible & Remote



Work from anywhere with flexibility in your schedule while maintaining consistent communication through Google Chat, Gmail, and Google Meet.



Room To Grow



As the agency grows, there will be opportunities for additional hours, increased compensation, and expanded responsibilities.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure websites are mobile-friendly and responsive

Landing Pages & Funnels

• Create new templates for future funnel use

• Improve conversion-focused page layouts

• Experience working with Duda or a similar builder

• Independent Contractor Position

Responsibilities

, and chat with professionalism and accuracy.

• Backup solutions for both power and internet outages.

• Customer-focused - complaints are opportunities to improve systems.

• Process-minded - you document and refine workflows naturally.



Work Schedule:

• Full-time, 40 hours/week

• US business hours: 9 PM–6 AM or 10 PM–7 AM PHT

• 1-hour break

• Five days per week



You're NOT a Fit If:

• You need micromanagement or detailed daily task lists

• You can't work 9 PM–7 AM PHT consistently

• You experience frequent power/internet outages without backup solutions

• You view this as temporary income between other opportunities



Before You Apply - Please Confirm:

• Weekly payments for the first 4 weeks (starting from week 3), then bi-monthly every other Tuesday.

• Full-time role, US hours.

• Must be open to a two-month trial period.

• Daily End of Shift (EOS) report answering:

a) What did you do today? (detailed description)

b) What issues did you run into?

c) Anything you need help with?

If you agree to all terms, write “I AGREE TO ALL TERMS” and answer the questions below.



Application Instructions (Follow Exactly) -



Subject Line:

[Your First Name] – I Am Your New E-commerce Assistant Store Manager

Example: Kevin – I Am Your New E-commerce Assistant Store Manager



Submit:

• Cover letter (focused on relevant e-commerce experience)

• Resume



Answer These Questions (Complete Sentences Required):

1. Describe your most relevant e-commerce operations experience (platforms used, team size, order volume, responsibilities).

2. What specific Shopify tasks have you performed?

3. What are your current work commitments and availability?

4. Provide your internet speed (include screenshot), computer specifications, and backup solutions for power & internet issues.

5. Provide one example of a difficult customer situation you handled and how you resolved it.

6. Why are you interested in this specific role instead of other VA positions?



Important: AI-generated or template responses will be immediately disqualified. We're looking for thoughtful, specific answers that demonstrate you read and understood this posting.

title: Low Voltage Construction Estimator (Fire Alarm, CCTV, Fiber, Access Control)
description:
Remote Low Voltage Estimator — Philippines



We are looking for a remote Low Voltage Estimator based in the Philippines with a strong electrical engineering, electrical construction, or low voltage construction background.



This role will support estimating and bidding for low voltage systems on U.S.-based construction projects. The ideal candidate has direct experience reviewing plans, specifications, addenda, and bid documents, and understands how low voltage projects are estimated and quoted in the U.S. market.



Responsibilities

Prepare estimates for low voltage systems, including:

Fire alarm

CCTV / video surveillance

Access control

Fiber optic cabling

Structured cabling and related systems

Review drawings, specifications, schedules, addenda, and bid documents.

Perform takeoffs from construction drawings.

Identify scope gaps, exclusions, alternates, and bid risks.

Request and organize material quotes from U.S.-based vendors, distributors, and manufacturers.

Coordinate with suppliers to obtain accurate pricing, lead times, and product availability.

Understand project requirements, manufacturer specifications, and approved product lists.

Assist with bid preparation, clarifications, and proposal documentation.

Requirements

Located in the Philippines and able to work remotely.

2–3+ years of experience estimating low voltage systems.

Background in electrical engineering, electrical construction, low voltage construction, or a related field.

Experience estimating U.S.-based projects is strongly preferred.

Ability to read and interpret U.S. construction drawings, specifications, and bid documents.

Familiarity with major low voltage manufacturers and product lines.

Experience sourcing material pricing from U.S. vendors, distributors, and manufacturers.

Strong understanding of how U.S. construction bids are prepared and submitted.

Proficiency with takeoff and estimating tools.

Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.

Preferred Experience

Prior experience with fire alarm estimating in the U.S. market.

Familiarity with fire alarm manufacturer dealership requirements.

Understanding that certain fire alarm manufacturers require authorized dealer status, territory rights, or certification before a contractor can purchase, install, program, or service their systems.

Ability to determine where to find manufacturer dealership or authorized distributor requirements.

Experience working with brands commonly used in the U.S. low voltage market.

Experience supporting electrical contractors, low voltage contractors, or systems integrators.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate understands that low voltage estimating is not just a material takeoff exercise. They know how to review specifications, identify approved manufacturers, confirm vendor pricing, understand manufacturer restrictions, and help prepare complete and accurate bids for U.S. construction projects.



This is a remote role for someone who is detail-oriented, technically capable, and already familiar with how low voltage systems are estimated in the U.S. construction market.

title: SAAS Customer Success Manager
description:
We're Hiring: Customer Success Manager (Remote)



We're Strid CRM, a GoHighLevel-based platform built specifically for real estate and land investors. Our mission is to make sure every client who joins us not only stays, but actually runs a better business because of it.



As we scale, we're looking for a Customer Success Manager who combines genuine people skills with deep platform knowledge. You will be the person our clients rely on when they need help, and the person we rely on to keep them from leaving.



This role requires real GoHighLevel expertise. You will be configuring sub-accounts, troubleshooting automations, guiding A2P registration, and running technical onboarding calls every week. If that excites you, keep reading.



What You'll Do



Onboard every new customer, hands-on.

You lead 1:1 onboarding calls with new subscribers and walk them through the full technical setup: pipeline configuration, custom fields, lead imports, phone number setup, call forwarding, A2P/10DLC SMS registration, and the AI agent. You will also guide customers migrating from platforms like Pebble, Follow Up Boss, Podio, and Salesforce. The goal is to get each customer to their "aha 
nt," the point where the platform clicks, as fast as possible.



Monitor account health and get ahead of churn.

You track every account weekly using GoCSM, segmenting customers into health tiers. When someone goes quiet, you reach out before they cancel. When someone does cancel, you have the retention conversation, collect the real feedback, and d
 whether a save is possible. You own the outcome either way.



Handle the hard technical stuff.

You are the escalation point for complex platform issues: broken automations, phone porting failures, Zapier integration bugs, lead routing problems, and snapshot rollouts. You coordinate with the dev and ops team when something needs to go deeper, and you document the fix so it doesn't happen again.



Manage a small support team.

You oversee one or two GHL support reps who handle first-line tickets. You train them, write their SOPs, hold them accountable, and make sure client issues get resolved without needing to escalate everything to you.



Build training resources and documentation.

You create training modules for customers on features like Smart Lists, automations, and pipeline management. You maintain SOPs for your own role. You contribute to group training calls when needed.



Be the voice of the customer internally.

You join a weekly alignment call with the CEO to review account health, churn signals, and product friction. The best product improvements we've made have come from this feedback loop, and that will continue with you in this seat.



What We're Looking For



Deep GoHighLevel experience: this is the job.

You need to be able to build and troubleshoot workflows, configure sub-accounts, manage snapshots, set up smart lists, and guide customers through A2P registration without Googling it. "Comfortable with GHL" is not enough for this role.



Excellent English communication.

Confident and warm on Zoom calls. Clear and professional in writing. Most of your clients are US-based operators who are not particularly technical; you need to explain complex setups in plain language without making anyone feel lost.



A proactive mindset.

You do not wait for tickets. You notice when a customer has not logged in for two weeks and you pick up the phone. You flag churn risk before it becomes a cancellation.



Organized and reliable.

You follow through, document what you do, and take ownership of your accounts without needing to be chased.



Requirements

- 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or SaaS Support

- Deep hands-on GoHighLevel experience (required: will be tested in the interview)

- Working knowledge of A2P / 10DLC SMS registration and phone porting

-  Experience building and troubleshooting GHL automations, workflows, and smart lists

- Comfortable running daily screen-share video calls with clients

- Strong written and spoken English

- Experience managing or mentoring junior support staff

- Availability to overlap with US Eastern or Central time



Bonus Points

- Experience in land investing, real estate acquisition, or a related industry

- Familiarity with GoCSM or similar customer health tools

- Experience with Zapier or n8n integrations

- Background migrating clients from Pebble, Follow Up Boss, Podio, or Salesforce



Why Strid



We are a focused, fast-moving team with a clear niche and a growing client base. You will not be one of fifty CSMs working from a script. You will have real ownership, a direct line to leadership, and the ability to shape how customer success works here as we scale. This role has genuine growth potential; the person who grows with us will eventually lead the entire CS function.



Compensation & Details

- Full-time (part-time considered for exceptional candidates)

- Remote, global applicants welcome

- Competitive rate based on experience and communication fluency

- Direct reporting relationship to CEO



How to Apply



Submit the following using the application form below:




/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdlzmYD0tRqEW7Bx1UbDHTX22MHVn0Ow4SrIgYQ30VId5votA/viewform



1. Your resume

2. A professional photo

3. A 1 to 2 minute Loom video answering these two questions:

title: Chief of Staff (Executive Assistant to CEO) — Electrical Contractor
description:
Chief of Staff (Executive Assistant to CEO) — Electrical Contractor, USA



Company: Coharbor Electric LLC — Cape Coral / Fort Myers, Florida (USA)

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (you must work USA business hours)

Location: 100% Remote — Philippines-based

Compensation: Depending on experience. Paid via Wise. Long-term, full-time role with room to grow as we double.

Start: As soon as we find the right person.





Who We Are



Coharbor Electric is a veteran-owned, Christian-owned residential and commercial electrical contractor serving Southwest Florida since 2010. We were founded by our CEO, Jacob Anderson — a Major in the U.S. Air Force — and we are a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business. We do service work, panel and service changes, generator and EV-charger installs, new construction, and larger commercial projects including fire stations.



Our mission is simple and we mean it: "To provide high quality electrical work, on time, with integrity. Our purpose is to empower and lift up our employees, customers, partners, and fellow community members." We treat our customers the way we'd treat our own family, we use honest flat-rate pricing with no upsell scripts, and we live by a verse we keep in front of us: "Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord" (Colossians 3:23). We say we're "bringing light to a dark world," and we mean that about more than wiring.



That value — to empower and lift up our employees — is why this role exists. We are a team of about 20, and we intend to double. The thing slowing us down isn't demand; it's that too much runs through one desk. We're hiring a Chief of Staff to change that. Of our team of 20, we do have 5 employees in PH already. 



This is not a "send me tasks and I'll do them" job. This is a build-and-own job. We have a list of programs we've wanted to launch for a while and haven't had the bandwidth to build. Your job is to take them off the CEO's plate, build them, run them, and keep them running — and to organize the back office so leadership can stop living in the inbox.



If you want to be told exactly what to do every hour, this is the wrong role. If you see a mess and instinctively build the system that fixes it — and you want to work for a company whose word actually means something — keep reading.





What You'll Own



1. Inbox & Communication (the CEO should rarely touch
)





Take full ownership of the CEO's
 inbox: triage, organize, label/folder, and clear it out.

Build a daily system: what needs the CEO, what you've handled, what's FYI.

Over your first 60–90 days, earn the trust to draft and then send routine replies on the CEO's behalf, reporting back in a single daily summary. The goal is simple: the CEO stops checking
.





2. Microsoft Teams — Organize It





Restructure Microsoft Teams: channels, files, naming conventions, and folder logic so the whole company can find what it needs.

Keep it organized as we grow.





3. Launch & Run Operational Programs (the core of this role)

You will build these from the ground up, document them, and then run them:





Installer Bonus Program — design and administer a performance bonus structure for our install crews.

Weekly Sales Tech Commissions — calculate and run sales technician commissions every week, accurately and on time.

Commercial Service Program — help stand up a recurring commercial service offering: the process, the workflow, the follow-up system.





4. Own the Hiring, Onboarding & Offboarding Process

We are doubling — you keep hiring organized and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. The CEO and our Technical Managers scan resumes and run the interviews; you own everything around that:





Post the jobs — write and publish job postings for open roles.

Schedule interviews — coordinate calendars and set up interviews between candidates and the CEO / Technical Managers.

Onboarding — once a candidate is hired, ensure 100% of onboarding paperwork is completed correctly and on time, and run them through the onboarding process.

Offboarding — when an employee parts ways, complete the offboarding paperwork and process accurately and discreetly.

Build and maintain the checklists and document templates that make onboarding and offboarding repeatable every single time.





5. Build Our Operating System (SOPs & Documentation)





Create SOPs, process documentation, templates, and operational systems — and do it for an electrical contracting business, where the details matter.

Turn "how we do things" out of the CEO's head and into written, repeatable systems.





6. Personal Assistant Support for the CEO

This role also supports the CEO personally. You will:





Book personal and business appointments and manage the CEO's calendar.

Set up and coordinate returns to retailers (initiate returns, schedule pickups, track refunds).

Categorize personal and family expenses and help maintain the family budget.

Handle other personal-assistant tasks as they come up — this person is a trusted right hand in both business and personal logistics.







What We Need From You



Required





3+ years supporting a CEO, founder, or executive as a Chief of Staff or high-level Executive Assistant — not a general/entry-level VA role.

Proven track record building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — please be ready to show examples of operational systems you have built.

Strong, professional written and spoken English. You will communicate on the CEO's behalf.

Comfort with numbers: you will run weekly commissions and a bonus program. Accuracy is non-negotiable.

Highly organized, proactive, and able to make sound decisions without being told.

Trustworthy and discreet — you will handle sensitive financial and personnel information.

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional remote setup.

Able and willing to work USA Eastern business hours, full-time.





A Strong Plus (not required)





Experience with ServiceTitan and/or QuickBooks.

Experience supporting a trades, construction, electrical, HVAC, or home-services company.

HR, recruiting coordination, or employee onboarding/offboarding experience.

Comfort using AI tools to work faster.







How We Work



We are direct, we move fast, and we value people who take ownership and tell us the truth — including when we're wrong. As a faith-driven, veteran-owned company, integrity matters more to us than anything on your resume. You will handle sensitive financial and personnel information and represent the CEO in writing, so trustworthiness isn't a nice-to-have here — it's the whole job. We measure this role on outcomes: programs launched, inbox controlled, systems built. Do that well and this role grows with the company as we double.





How to Apply



To prove you actually read this posting, start your application with the phrase: "Built to last." Applications without it will not be read.



Please send:





A short introduction telling us about a system, SOP, or program you personally built for a previous employer — what was broken, what you built, and the result.

Your resume.

Your desired monthly rate in USD.

Your earliest available start date.

One sentence on why a remote role on US Eastern hours works for you long-term.





We review every complete application. We look forward to meeting you.

title: Front-End Developer — Sports Analytics Platform
description:
About the Role

We are building a multi-sport analytics platform that displays player prop lines, team odds, ladder standings and match data across AFL, NRL, NBA, NHL, NFL and more. We need a developer who can write clean vanilla JavaScript and Python — no frameworks, no unnecessary complexity.

What You'll Do

• Build and maintain player stats pages — game logs, averages, prop line comparisons

• Write Python scripts to scrape and parse sports data from public websites (FootyWire, etc.) and output clean JSON

• Set up and maintain Netlify serverless functions to proxy third-party API calls (OddsAPI, etc.)

• Update ladder, fixtures and results each round — keeping static data files current

• Extend coverage to new sports and markets as the platform grows

• Polish mobile layout, load speed and dark/light theme



You Must Know

• HTML / CSS / Vanilla JavaScript  (no React, no Vue — pure DOM work)

• Python 3  (requests, BeautifulSoup — web scraping and data formatting)

• REST APIs  (fetching JSON, handling rate limits, caching responses)

• Netlify  (static hosting + serverless functions in Node.js)

• Git  (clean commits, feature branches)



Nice to Have

• Knowledge of Australian football (AFL) or rugby league (NRL) — understanding the stats matters

• Familiarity with sports betting markets — disposals, tackles, player props

• Experience with FootyWire or Squiggle API data

• Basic charting (Chart.js or similar)



Important

Do not apply if your first move is to rewrite everything in React or add a build pipeline. This project values clean, readable vanilla code. We are not looking for the most technically impressive solution — we are looking for the simplest one that works.



Paid Trial Task (~2–3 hours)

Shortlisted applicants will be given a trial task before any ongoing commitment:



How to Apply

Send a short message with:

• A link to 2–3 projects you have built (GitHub preferred)

• One example of a Python scraping script you have written

• Your availability and hourly rate in AUD

• One sentence about why sports data interests you



Applications without code samples will not be considered.

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
Executive Recruiter / HR Specialist | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



You're not just filling seats. You're protecting the standard every hire either raises or lowers.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



This is not a transactional recruiting role.



We're looking for an Executive Recruiter who operates as both a strategic hiring partner and trusted advisor — to clients, to leadership, and to the candidates moving through the process. You'll manage full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles while supporting the HR operations that keep the internal team running well.



You'll work directly with clients to understand their business and what a great hire looks like — then go build it. The judgment calls you make directly shape the teams clients trust us to build. We need someone who takes that seriously.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best recruiters we've worked with share a few traits:



They protect the bar. When a candidate is almost right, they don't talk themselves into a yes — they know a weak hire is never the safe option, just a delayed and more expensive problem.



They're honest even when it costs them. If a role brief is unclear, they push back. If a candidate isn't the right fit, they say so — directly, kindly, and early.



They're genuinely curious. They don't run the same interview script for every role — they study the business, ask questions other recruiters miss, and keep getting sharper at reading people over time.



They build systems, not just pipelines. Every hiring cycle produces something better than the last — tighter screening, cleaner processes, sharper evaluation criteria.



Who Thrives Here



People who care deeply about quality — in who they hire, in how they advise clients, and in how they work. You find satisfaction in identifying the right person. You take it personally when a weak candidate slips through. You're organized, direct, and comfortable making judgment calls without needing consensus.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is built yet. For the right person, that's the opportunity to build the systems that scale with the business, not just manage what already exists.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where clients need to hire well across multiple roles, industries, and seniority levels — and where the quality of every hire reflects directly on our company.



That looks like:



Managing full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles — from intake through offer, owning every step



Leading intake calls with clients — understanding their business, pushing back when a brief isn't clear enough to hire well against, and providing strategic hiring recommendations when needed



Proactively sourcing and headhunting candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, networks, and AI-powered tools — not waiting for applications



Conducting structured interviews that assess mindset, ownership, communication, and cultural fit — not just credentials



Presenting candidates with clear, honest hiring recommendations so clients make better decisions faster



Writing and posting culture-fit job descriptions across all platforms that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones



Supporting HR operations — onboarding, contractor documentation, records management, and internal policy compliance



Tracking recruitment metrics and pipeline health — surfacing what's working and what needs to change



Building and improving recruitment SOPs, interview guides, scorecards, and onboarding checklists



Using AI tools to accelerate sourcing, screening, and communication without cutting corners on quality



What We're Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to; clients and candidates always feel heard



Strong full-cycle recruitment experience — executive, technical, and specialized roles across multiple clients or industries



Proven client communication and stakeholder management skills — you run intake calls, push back on vague briefs, and advise with confidence



Sharp interviewing and candidate assessment ability — you probe for specifics and can tell the difference between someone who sounds good and someone who actually is



Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent) — daily use, not occasional



Strong proactive sourcing and headhunting skills — you build pipelines, you don't wait for them



Proficiency in ATS platforms and HR tools (Workable, ClickUp, or equivalent)



High integrity and sound judgment — honest calls, confidential information handled without exceptions



Self-directed once you understand the environment — but asks the right questions early



Nice to Have



Experience in executive search, agency recruitment, or outsourcing environments



Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand how we hire, our clients, our tools, and how the business operates. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly — and significant latitude to shape how we hire and build the team.



We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like

At three months:



You've run multiple full-cycle searches end-to-end. Your candidate assessments are sharp, honest, and already what leadership and clients rely on. You know the business well enough to push back on a vague brief.



At six months:



Hiring is faster and more consistent. JDs are stronger. Screening is tighter. Onboarding is more structured. Recruitment metrics are visible and being used to improve the process.



At twelve months:



We hire better because of the systems you built. Weak candidates don't make it through. Strong ones move quickly. Clients trust your judgment — and we're investing in your continued growth.



How We Work



You won't be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and give them the space to do it. Meaningful work means making decisions — and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn and move forward.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You treat hiring as a numbers game — more applications, faster fills



You talk yourself into candidates who are almost right because the pipeline is thin



You present candidates without a clear, honest recommendation behind them



You need a fully built system handed to you



You're uncomfortable pushing back on clients or leadership when the direction isn't right



You've never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don't intend to start



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth
